content.title: All About Adam Sandler’s Two Kids, Sadie and Sunny (and the Acting Advice He Gives Them)
content.text: Sunny Sandler, Adam Sandler, Jackie Sandler and Sadie Sandler at the "Roommates" premiere in 2026. Credit: Axelle/Bauer-Griffin/FilmMagic Adam Sandler and his wife, Jackie, have welcomed two daughters: Sadie and Sunny.Sadie arrived in May 2006, while Sunny was born in November 2008.Both Sadie and Sunny have acted in multiple projects alongside their dad, including You Are So Not Invited To My Bat Mitzvah. Adam Sandler is a proud girl dad. The Uncut Gems star shares daughters Sadie and Sunny with his wife, Jackie Sandler, whom he met on the set of Big Daddy in 1999. They married in 2003 at Dick Clark’s Malibu estate, and welcomed their two children a few years later: Sadie, born in May 2006, and Sunny, born in November 2008. Like their famous father, Sandler’s children have the acting bug. They’ve appeared in several of his films over the years, from Grownups to You Are So Not Invited To My Bat Mitzvah. Yet they’re eager to step out of the Saturday Night Live alum’s shadow, Sandler revealed in a 2020 appearance on The Drew Barrymore Show. "I say, 'You are, you were in this, this, and this,' and they go, 'Not yours,'” he said. “I go, 'Oh, Daddy's not good enough!' They wanna do their own thing one day." Most recently, Sadie scored the leading role in the Netflix comedy Roommates, where she plays a college freshman dealing with roommate drama. Adam served as a producer and played the role of proud dad at the Los Angeles premiere. Adam Sandler, Jackie Sandler and Sadie Sandler at a Los Angeles Lakers game in February 2024. Allen Berezovsky/Getty Images Jokes aside, Sadie and Sunny are making their parents proud. In 2025, Sandler told E! News about the joys of working with his kids, who appeared in Happy Gilmore 2 alongside him that year. “Once they do (the job) well, nothing feels better as a parent," he said. "It must be like when you're the parents of a baseball player and you're at the game and they get a hit. You just go, 'Thank god.' It's just so much relief." Ahead, find out everything the Sandlers have shared about their kids. Sadie Sandler Sadie Sandler, Jackie Sandler, Adam Sandler and Sunny Sandler at the 2024 Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Awards. Monica Schipper/Getty Images Sadie Sandler was born in May 2006 in Los Angeles, California. Her parents kept her largely out of the public eye as she grew up, save for several appearances on the silver screen. She starred in several of her father's films, such as Bedtime Stories (2008), Grownups (2010), and Grownups 2 (2013). At 17, she voiced Jayda in her father's Netflix movie, Leo. In 2023, Adam, Jackie, Sadie, and Sunny appeared in You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah, a Netflix film in which Sandler’s character is the dad to his IRL daughters, Stacy Friedman (Sunny) and Ronnie Friedman (Sadie). Their mom Jackie also appears in the film. As for Sadie's own 2019 bat mitzvah, her dad had a special surprise in store: a performance by Adam Levine and Maroon 5, People reports. Sandler explained on Jimmy Kimmel Live that he asked Levine over text, saying, "I'm sorry to do this to you, my kid's getting bat mitzvahed Saturday night. Would you mind coming and singing a few tunes?" The favor paid off in Sadie's delighted reaction. "Oh, she hugged me so much, my Sadie," Sandler said. It was a characteristic move for Sandler, who seems willing to do anything for his daughters. As he once told the HuffPost, “I’m a worrier. I’ve learned now that when your kid is upset, you’re rocked until they’re not upset anymore. Even when they’re not upset, you’re rocked. You’re always nervous because you want your kid to be happy.” Related Stories In April 2026, Sandler, Jackie, and Sadie’s younger sister Sunny hit the red carpet to support Sadie at the premiere of her Netflix comedy Roommates. In the film, the 19-year-old plays an incoming college freshman who experiences friction with her cool-girl roommate. “Honestly, every character in the film is dealing with a certain type of loneliness, and finding your place, and I feel like everyone goes through those times where you don’t know where you fit in,” the rising star shared in an appearance on The Drew Barrymore Show ahead of the film’s release. Sunny Sandler Jackie Sandler, Adam Sandler, Sunny Sandler, and Sadie Sandler at the premiere of Netflix's "Spaceman" on February 26, 2024. Rodin Eckenroth/Getty Images Sandler and Jackie welcomed their second daughter, Sunny Sandler, in November 2008 in Los Angeles, California. Like Sadie, Sunny quickly began acting in her father's films, including Blended, Murder Mystery, Leo, and You’re So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah. When it came time for his youngest daughter's bat mitzvah, Sandler once again pulled out all the stops, including performances by Charlie Puth and Halsey. Also in attendance? Jennifer Aniston and Taylor Lautner, NBD. Besides acting, Sunny has also taken an interest in singing. In 2019, she joined her dad on stage at one of his comedy shows to perform "A Million Dreams" from The Greatest Showman. That same year, Sunny and her sister joined their dad on stage at a charity event, the Rock4EB! fundraiser concert, where the trio performed Taylor Swift's "Lover," People reports. While having parents in Hollywood has come with perks for Sadie and Sunny, they aren’t afraid to poke fun at their A-list father, either. At the 2022 Gotham Awards, Sandler took home a performer tribute award, expressing his thanks with an acceptance speech written by Sadie and Sunny. On stage, he told the crowd that when he confessed to not having written a speech, his daughters offered their services. "I said, 'Absolutely! It would be nice to see you doing something other than watching YouTube.’” Sunny, Sadie, Jackie, and Adam Sandler at the Venice International Film Festival in August 2025. Daniele Venturelli/WireImage The speech included several playful jabs at their beloved father. "(This award) means a lot to him,” Sandler read, “seeing how most of the awards on his trophy shelf are shaped like popcorn buckets, blimps or fake mini Oscars that say 'Father of the Year,' which he sadly purchased himself while wandering in a self-pitying fog through the headshops of Times Square.” Sunny will soon step into a leading role herself, as her musical teen drama Don’t Say Good Luck is set to hit Netflix sometime in 2026. The film, which is produced by Sandler, counts Melanie Lynskey, Steve Buscemi, and Jack Champion among its stacked cast, per Deadline. Although they often work as a family unit, Sandler encourages both his children to study other talent. “Our kids want to be actors. And we go, ‘Well, watch Carey [Mulligan],’” he told People in 2024. (Mulligan and Sandler co-starred in that year’s sci-fi drama Spaceman.) His other golden advice? “Be nice to everybody,” the comedian revealed to Fox News Digital in 2025, adding, “The crew is all you got. They work their asses off.”
